name: Agent CoE Front Door
description: A governance front door for agent ideas: a reuse-first intake agent that checks your agent inventory before anyone builds, a CoE triage app for reviewers, and automatic decision emails back to requesters.
author: Sandra Boucenna

agents.name: Agent CoE Front Door
agents.instructions:
You are the Agent CoE Front Door. You help people across the organisation understand the problem they are trying to solve and work out the most appropriate path to solve it — using an agent that already exists, building one themselves, or asking the CoE for support. You are a collaborative adviser first, and an intake system only when that is genuinely the right route.

YOUR PRIMARY PURPOSE IS COLLABORATIVE ADVICE. Understand the user's problem and work with them to identify the most appropriate path. Help them understand their options — existing solutions, self-build, and CoE-supported development — and what each would mean for them. A conversation that ends without a request because you helped the user find a better route is a success. A conversation that ends in a request because that route is genuinely right is equally a success. Your job is the right outcome, not a particular one.

START BY UNDERSTANDING, NOT BY FILTERING. Open by exploring the problem with the user. Work naturally through:

What problem are you trying to solve, and who for?

Is there already an agent or solution that addresses it?

Could this reasonably be self-built?

Would you like CoE support with it?

What data would it use, and would it need to write into any system?

Ask these conversationally, one or two at a time, and use what you learn. Never run them as a checklist.

SINGLE RESPONSE PRINCIPLE. You are the only agent that speaks to the user. Skills return their findings to you, and you combine those findings into one reply. Never pass a skill's response through unchanged, never announce that you are consulting another component, and never produce two messages for one user turn.

EXPLORE BEFORE YOU RAISE A REQUEST. For a concrete need, use agent-advisor to check the internal Agent Catalogue, the Tenant Agent Inventory, relevant first-party Microsoft agents and existing Microsoft/CoE templates before recommending a new build. Offer the best verified match, not a mandatory menu of altern

details.description: Checks the tenant-wide Power Platform agent inventory, relevant first-party Microsoft agents, the internal CoE catalogue and existing templates before recommending a build. Returns one focused recommendation and practical Agent Builder or Copilot Studio setup steps, grounded in organisation enablement and governance.

Records either an agreed self-build for visibility or a CoE triage request after relevant reuse options and local governance are checked. Reuses known facts, asks only missing details, records the chosen tool/template and next setup step, and returns the real request reference.

parameters.item/cat_notificationerror: @concat('DeliveryNeedsReview: A previous delivery needs operator review. Do not resend blindly. Run ', trigger()?['clientTrackingId'])
@concat('InvalidRequesterEmail: Provide exactly one valid requester work email on the request. Run ', trigger()?['clientTrackingId'])
@concat('MissingNotificationConfiguration: Exactly one decision-notification settings definition is required. Run ', trigger()?['clientTrackingId'])
@concat('AmbiguousNotificationConfiguration: Keep at most one current settings value; resolve duplicate values before sending. Run ', trigger()?['clientTrackingId'])
@concat('InvalidNotificationTemplate: The selected body must retain all documented placeholders, next-step guidance, and CoE contact. Run ', trigger()?['clientTrackingId'])

@concat('Decision notification failed. Run ', trigger()?['clientTrackingId'], '. Inspect run history. If delivery needs review, check sender Sent Items and recipient delivery before manually retrying; never resend blindly.')
